pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit irregular, roughly polygonal geometries with low-frequency edge gradients across the visible surface. Patches occupy the majority of the spatial area relative to the inter-patch channels.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative space consists of light-toned interstitial pathways forming a topological graph with prominent tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of these pathways is consistently narrow and maintains structural continuity.
